h: The Enduring Radiance of the Third Shabbos Meal

p: no Kiddush over wine was instituted,
and according to the revealed level
we have not found a clear reason.
And there is also the difference:
that at night we ask for the light,
and we say, "Let us invite her now," etc.,
that the light should come of itself;
and likewise "light will reach her," etc.
And likewise in the morning we say,
But at the third meal we say,
הַיְינוּ רַק מִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ חֵשֶׁק לְמֶיחֱזֵי
that is, only one who has a yearning to see;
וְכֵן אַחַר כָּךְ צְבוּ לַחֲדָא כּוּלֵּי
and likewise afterward, "desire it greatly," etc.,
that the will and the yearning be very great.
And also, in the two preceding meals
וְכָאן רַק לְמֶיחֱזֵי זִיו דִּזְעֵיר אַנְפִּין
while here only "to see the radiance of Ze'ir Anpin."
And in the holy Zohar (this parsha, III 117b):
"For from it radiance goes forth to the world,
and therefore it is called," etc.;
"for the radiance of all goes forth from it,
וְעַל דָּא כְּתִיב יְבָרֶכְךָ ה׳ מִצִּיּוֹן
and therefore it is written, 'May Hashem bless you from Tziyon'
and it is all one thing," etc.
"And this is the light of the world,
as it is written, 'From Tziyon, the perfection of beauty,
הוֹפִיעַ מֵהַר פָּארָן (דְּבָרִים לג, ב) כּוּלֵּי
'He shone forth from Mount Paran' (Devarim 33:2)," etc.
that Tziyon is one thing with radiance.
And in this pasuk there are two levels:
He shone forth from Mount Paran."
that the light is the aspect of the primordial light
it reckons the utterance "Let there be light"
which is the intellect hidden from all thought.
And the sun's substance is fire;
that is, as the primordial light was
and this is the aspect of fire.
And the nations of the world count by the sun:
הַיְינוּ לַחַמָּה כְּמוֹ שֶׁהוּא עַתָּה בְּנַרְתִּקָהּ
that is, by the sun as it is now in its sheath.
And regarding the future it is written,
וְהָיָה אוֹר הַלְּבָנָה כְּאוֹר הַחַמָּה וְגוֹ׳ (יְשַׁעְיָה ל, כו)
"And the light of the moon shall be like the light of the sun" etc. (Yeshayahu 30:26);
it emerges that the sun in this world
is truly only the aspect of light,
which receives from the light of the sun.
Only the nations of the world count by the sun
and think that it is the sun,
And in the future, when HaKadosh Baruch Hu takes
the sun out of its sheath,
and it will be in the aspect of fire,
the primordial light before it was hidden,
and the wicked are judged by it.
And Yisrael count by the moon,
for they receive only the light;
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (שְׁמוֹת רַבָּה סוֹף פָּרָשָׁה טו)
and as written (Shemos Rabbah, end of chapter 15, 15:27):
the secret of the moon to Yisrael,
that they should count by it," etc.,
"and just as the moon is of light,
as it says, 'Light is sown' etc."
also count by the moon, as is known;
וְהַיְינוּ הַלְּבָנָה כְּמוֹ שֶׁהוּא בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה
that is, the moon as it is in this world,
וְהִיא מְקַבֶּלֶת רַק מֵהַחַמָּה שֶׁבָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה
which receives only from the sun of this world,
which is the light in the sun,
that is, fire in its sheath;
and the moon in this world
is only radiance and shining forth.
that the whole world is called "the house of wine,"
and it is expounded in the Midrash Rabbah (this parsha, Bamidbar Rabbah 2:3):
like the number of the seventy nations.
that in truth the whole world was created
so that there be in them only words of Torah;
and had there not been the downfall,
all the descendants of Adam HaRishon would have been
and they would have been called "the house of wine,"
like the number of the seventy nations.
it was found to be all vinegar.
And the heads of the kelipos
are the kelipos of Esav and Yishmael:
thirty-five on the right, the kelipah of Yishmael,
and thirty-five on the left, the kelipah of Esav.
And the nations from the kelipah of Esav
which is in truth the light,
וְעַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בַּמִּדְרָשׁ (אֵיכָה ב, ט)
and according to what is written in the Midrash (on Eichah 2:9, Eichah Rabbah 2:13):
"If one says there is wisdom in Edom, believe it,
וְהַאֲבַדְתִּי חֲכָמִים מֵאֱדוֹם וְגוֹ׳ (עוֹבַדְיָה א, ח)
'And I will destroy the wise men from Edom' etc. (Ovadiah 1:8);
if one says there is Torah, do not believe it,
דִּכְתִיב בַּגּוֹיִם אֵין תּוֹרָה (אֵיכָה ב, ט)
as it is written, 'Among the nations there is no Torah'" (Eichah 2:9);
that is, it does not teach his heart at all.
to conquer the whole world under their hand,
וְאוֹמְרִים כֹּחִי וְעֹצֶם יָדִי וְגוֹ׳ (דְּבָרִים ח, יז)
and they say, "My strength and the might of my hand" etc. (Devarim 8:17),
פֶּן בַּחֶרֶב אֵצֵא וְגוֹ׳ (בְּמִדְבַּר כ, יח)
"lest I go out with the sword" etc. (Bamidbar 20:18).
And at the time of Mattan Torah
its light was given to Yisrael,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג קצב, ב)
וְעַל זֶה נֶאֱמַר וְזָרַח מִשֵּׂעִיר לָמוֹ
and about this it says, "And He dawned from Se'ir upon them,"
וְהוּא הָאוֹר שֶׁל תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
And this is the light of Torah she'b'al peh,
עַל מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר כִּי צַיִד בְּפִיו (בְּרֵאשִׁית כה, כח)
on what is said, "for game was in his mouth" (Bereishis 25:28)
And the children of Yishmael, who count by the moon
כְּמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר כִּי שֶׁמֶשׁ וּמָגֵן ה׳ (תְּהִלִּים פד, יב)
as it says, "For Hashem is a sun and a shield" (Tehillim 84:12)
and this radiance was given to Yisrael.
וְעַל זֶה נֶאֱמַר הוֹפִיעַ מֵהַר פָּארָן
And about this it says, "He shone forth from Mount Paran":
as written in the holy Zohar
And to the kelipah of Esav was given the power of the light
from the thirty-five on the left that is found in it,
and to the kelipah of Yishmael was given the power of the radiance
from the thirty-five on the right included in it.
"But for you who fear My Name
there shall shine a sun of righteousness, with healing" (Malachi 3:20),
and likewise it is expounded in the Gemara (Nedarim 8b)
שֶׁהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא מוֹצִיא חַמָּה מִנַּרְתִּיקָהּ
that HaKadosh Baruch Hu takes the sun out of its sheath:
and not only that, but they delight in it."
For Shabbos is a semblance of the World to Come,
אֶחָד מִשִּׁשִּׁים לָעוֹלָם הַבָּא (בְּרָכוֹת נז, ב)
one-sixtieth of the World to Come (Berachos 57b);
and then Yisrael merit the primordial light.
And so it is written explicitly in Sefer HaBahir:
and placed it for them in its place,
and the rest He hid away for the righteous
for the future to come, etc.
And at the night meal we say,
אַךְ הוּא רַק בִּבְחִינַת אוֹר מַקִּיף
but it is only as surrounding light,
וְזֶה בָּא מִצַּד הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ מֵעַצְמוֹ
And this comes from the side of Hashem Yisbarach of itself,
"to know that I am Hashem who sanctifies you";
and likewise "light will reach her," etc.
And in the morning, at the meal of Atika,
we say, "May His light rest upon it":
that the light enters the heart;
וְהוּא גַּם כֵּן יִשְׁרֵי בַהּ מֵעַצְמוֹ
and it too "rests upon it" of itself,
This is not so with the third meal,
at the close of the Shabbos day:
אָז זוֹכִין רַק לְזִיוָא דִּזְעֵיר אַנְפִּין
then we merit only the radiance of Ze'ir Anpin;
וְזֶה גַּם כֵּן אֵינוֹ בָּא מִמֵּילָא
and this too does not come of itself,
רַק עַל יְדֵי הַחֵשֶׁק עָצוּם כַּנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל
but only through intense yearning, as mentioned above:
But in this is the advantage,
for this is the middah of Yaakov,
and "the lip of truth shall be established forever."
And as we ask in the Minchah prayer,
"Answer me with the truth of Your salvation."
תּוּשְׁבַּחְתָּא דַּאֲבָהָן (זֹהַר חֵלֶק א קסג, ב)
the glory of the Avos (Zohar I 163b):
for from Avraham dross came forth,
and although he himself is called Yisrael
and he also merited the light,
"'Let there be light' — this is Avraham";
מִכָּל מָקוֹם אַחַר כָּךְ לְאַחַר פְּטִירָתוֹ
it was nullified with regard to "the souls
that they had made in Charan" (Bereishis 12:5),
and also with regard to the dross of his offspring,
לוּ יִשְׁמָעֵאל יִחְיֶה לְפָנֶיךָ (בְּרֵאשִׁית יז, יח)
"If only Yishmael might live before You" (Bereishis 17:18).
And likewise Yitzchak, who is Torah
"the Torah comes from the side of Gevurah"
dross was found in his offspring,
as it says, "Among the nations there is no Torah."
מַה שֶּׁאֵין כֵּן הַזִּיו שֶׁל יַעֲקֹב
This is not so with the radiance of Yaakov:
And this is the matter of what is written
(טוּר וְשֻׁלְחָן עָרוּךְ אֶבֶן הָעֵזֶר סִימָן סב)
that Shabbos, at the night and morning meals,
but not at the third meal.
עַל יְדֵי הַנְּשָׁמָה יְתֵירָה שֶׁמַּשִּׂיג הָאָדָם
through the additional soul that a person attains,
"a man's wisdom lights up his face"
אָז כָּל אֶחָד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל פָּנִים חֲדָשׁוֹת
then each one of Yisrael is "new faces."
וְכֵן הוּא מְפוֹרָשׁ בְּתִיקּוּנֵי זֹהַר (תִּיקּוּן ו)
And so it is explicit in the Tikkunei Zohar (Tikkun 6):
that from the tzaddik there fly forth
new souls into Yisrael on Erev Shabbos,
נִקְרָא גַּם כֵּן כָּל אֶחָד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל
each one of Yisrael is likewise called
for at night the light was
as we said, "that shines upon our heads";
"may His light rest upon it" in the inwardness of the heart,
for the light has already entered the heart.
And about this it is stated in the Midrash
"'A psalm, a song for the Shabbos day':
and this is at the morning meal,
when one attains a new light
compared to the light one attains at night,
for it has already entered the heart.
This is not so with the third meal,
which is only the radiance of Ze'ir Anpin,
and even this does not come of itself,
רַק עַל יְדֵי הַחֵשֶׁק הָעָצוּם כַּנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל
but only through intense yearning, as mentioned above.
וּבֶאֱמֶת מִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ חֵשֶׁק נִפְלָא כָּזֶה
And in truth, one who has such wondrous yearning
and merits the radiance of Ze'ir Anpin
אֲבָל לָאו כָּל אָדָם זוֹכֶה לְכָךְ
but not every person merits this,
רַק הַזִּיו הַזֶּה נִשְׁאָר לְעוֹלְמֵי עַד
יֵשׁ גַּם כֵּן הִתְגַּלּוּת תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
there is also a revelation of Torah she'b'al peh,
which is the radiance of Ze'ir Anpin;
רַק בְּשַׁבָּת שֶׁהוּא מֵעֵין עוֹלָם הַבָּא
only on Shabbos, which is a semblance of the World to Come,
we merit to receive from the light,
And "the members of the palace who yearn,"
who have very great yearning and will,
they merit to have, even on weekdays,
and this is "the lip of truth shall be established forever."
And in this, Yaakov is the glory of the Avos.

p: and it is "the wine preserved in its grapes," etc.,
and it pertains to the night,
when there is a revelation of the primordial light:
And by day, "may His light rest upon it":
גַּם כֵּן שַׁיָּיךְ קִידּוּשָׁא רַבָּא עַל הַיַּיִן
here too the great Kiddush over wine is fitting;
for through the arousal from below
the light of Torah she'b'al peh.
This is not so with the third meal,
which is only the radiance of Ze'ir Anpin,
וְלֹא הַזְּרִיחָה מֵאוֹר תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
and not the shining forth of the light of Torah she'b'al peh;
לָכֵן לֹא בָּא בּוֹ קִידּוּשׁ עַל הַיַּיִן
therefore there is no Kiddush over wine at it.
only through the yearning and will
"in which is the Will of wills,"
for from this comes the joy,
that the radiance will remain forever.
But how can we be sure
that the radiance will remain forever?
"May they be taken outside and not come in,
that through the holiness of Shabbos
we can fulfill the eradication of Amalek,
and there will be no more evil at all.
"He will put them in their holes,
and they will hide among the rocks":
and there will be no more accusation at all,
and they will be sure of this radiance,
